description: Land Title Settlement Department - Waligalla, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320236 (23/0154)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Land Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed property descriptions, ownership details, and cadastral information. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership registration and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
